observations.command:
set -eu
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
stat -c %s /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/descriptors
wc -c < /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/descriptors
cat /proc/uptime
